name: fleet-orchestration
description: Run many Claude Code sessions on one codebase without them lying to each other. Ships the protocol (heartbeats, dispatch-routed addressing, ASSERTED vs DELIVERED, git and merge discipline), the evidence rules that survived a 38-merge multi-repo run, a staleness monitor that reads a lane's artifact before calling it silent, descending-model role definitions, and commands to start a fleet, take a census, and produce the founder decision sheet.

context.title: Fleet Orchestration
context.summary: Protocol, evidence rules, heartbeat monitor and descending-model role definitions for running many Claude Code sessions on one codebase. Repo list, lane names and paths are configuration, not hardcoded.
